svg.desc: Describe the app in the molecule.dev IDE, the mlcl CLI or any MCP agent, and Synthase assembles it from the open-source @molecule catalog. Every provider sits behind a swappable bond, so changing the database is one import, not a rewrite. Auth, payments, i18n, analytics, monitoring, tests and CI come wired in from day one. Built-in analytics, error tracking and feedback let the AI keep improving the app from real use. Faster, cheaper, higher-quality apps for web, mobile and API that stay easy to change.

g.text: Faster, cheaper, higher-quality apps for web, mobile and API that stay easy to change.
